items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: All of us was working here. ... Sugar Downer was glad to go.

ctx.x: To get back to Dewey, was he working here in town? Was he working here?

Well, he was here in town. All of us was here. See, all of us was working here. But of course I formed up. You see, this here, this fellow here, he was glad to go. Sugar Downer. Sugar Downer was glad to go. He, if I told him like today, he'd be glad to go since last night. Because he was in trouble. Well anyhow, let's explain about his trouble because he's dead now. I know he's out of his troubles now.
I never did know much about the figure Johnny.
